consequence.statement: Operators upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older with Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands must enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and use StrimziPodSets before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0, enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and use StrimziPodSets in the Strimzi 0.38-or-older cluster.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 requires that, when upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older with Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands, the StableConnectIdentities feature gate is enabled and StrimziPodSets are in use before the upgrade.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for migration migration-required
